name: Mission
source:
You're on a mission. Who are you? What's the mission? Where are you? You don't know.

Also there's cursing and a gun.

[From [url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/mission]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在執行任務。你是誰？任務是什麼？你在哪裡？你都不知道。

另外，這裡有髒話，還有一把槍。

[摘自[url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/mission]itch.io[/url]]
